scope: Exploratory deterministic geometry diagnostic from existing interweaving draws; no new sampling or target change
paths: spherical white-direction interpolation with linearly interpolated norm
controls: One pure amplitude/field-rescaling path with unchanged physical initial density
scalars: Interpolate amplitude and physical biases linearly between endpoints; separately profile all four bounded biases at fixed field/amplitude
profiling: Enumerate 3^4 active sets of a convex box-constrained Gaussian linear-bias likelihood, solve free coordinates, select minimum, certify KKT and full-target agreement
limits: Selected after observing separated chains; exploratory, not blind validation
Profiled potentials are not marginalized densities, evidence or configuration masses
A barrier on these paths need not occur on every possible path
Absence of a point-potential barrier does not establish easy typical-set mixing
No chains discarded, reweighted, restarted or extended
